original_title: Fortnite, Grand Theft Auto 5 Continue to Top PS5, Xbox Series X/S Most-Played Charts in the US
summary_en: Fortnite and GTA V are still kings of the castle, but a few surprises are making waves on the latest PS5 and Xbox Series X/S most-played charts.
ai_analysis: The enduring popularity of live-service giants continues to shape the gaming landscape, proving that consistent content trumps brand-new releases for many players.

en.title: 5 Games Still Dominating PS5 & Xbox Charts in 2026
en.summary: Fortnite and GTA V are still kings of the castle, but a few surprises are making waves on the latest PS5 and Xbox Series X/S most-played charts.
en.body:
The latest data on weekly active players for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S in the US shows a familiar picture at the top, with titans like Fortnite and Grand Theft Auto V refusing to cede their dominance. Mat Piscatella of Circana shared insights revealing that the vast majority of top-tier games are established live-service titles or annual sports entries, highlighting a market that thrives on ongoing engagement.

## 1. Fortnite
This battle royale behemoth, developed by Epic Games, continues its reign as the undisputed champion on both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Its consistent stream of new content, seasons, and collaborations keeps millions of players returning week after week, proving that free-to-play with endless updates is a winning formula.

## 2. Grand Theft Auto V Remastered
Rockstar Games' enduring crime saga, originally released in 2013 and remastered for current-gen consoles, remains a powerhouse. The persistent popularity of GTA Online, coupled with the anticipation for GTA 6, ensures that players are still logging massive hours in Los Santos, making it a fixture on any 'most-played' list.

## 3. Roblox
More than just a game, Roblox is a universe of user-generated experiences that appeals to a massive audience, particularly younger players. Its presence in the top ranks on both PlayStation and Xbox demonstrates the platform's incredible reach and its ability to foster a diverse and ever-evolving digital playground.

## 4. Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls
A notable newcomer on the PS5 charts, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls made a splash by debuting in the top 20. This fighting game, leveraging the vast Marvel IP, offers a fresh competitive experience that has clearly resonated with PlayStation players looking for new challenges.

## 5. Shift at Midnight
Similarly, Shift at Midnight managed to carve out a spot in the top 20 for Xbox Series X/S during its launch week. While details are scarce, its inclusion signifies a successful entry into a crowded market, offering Xbox players a new title to sink their teeth into.

Bottom Line: The charts continue to be dominated by evergreen live-service titles, with only a handful of new releases managing to break into the established elite.

tr.title: 2026'da PS5 ve Xbox'da Hâlâ Hüküm Süren 5 Oyun
tr.summary: Fortnite ve GTA V hâlâ zirvede hüküm sürerken, birkaç sürpriz PS5 ve Xbox Series X/S en çok oynanan oyunlar listesinde dalgalar yaratıyor. En yeni veriler, live-service oyunlarının ve yıllık spor girişlerinin piyasayı nasıl domine ettiğini gösteriyor.
tr.body:
PS5 ve Xbox Series X/S için haftalık aktif oyuncu verilerini inceleyerek, zirvedeki oyunların hala tanıdık isimlerden oluştuğunu görüyoruz. Circana'dan Mat Piscatella'nın paylaştığı bilgiler, en üst düzeydeki oyunların büyük çoğunluğunun live-service oyunları veya yıllık spor girişimleri olduğunu gösteriyor. Bu, sürekli etkileşimle yaşayan bir pazarı ortaya koyuyor.

## 1. Fortnite
Epic Games'in geliştirdiği bu battle royale devi, PS5 ve Xbox Series X/S'te hâlâ hüküm süren şampiyon olarak kabul ediliyor. Sürekli yeni içerik, sezonlar ve işbirlikleri, milyonlarca oyuncunun haftadan haftaya geri dönmesini sağlıyor. Bu, ücretsiz oynanabilen ve sürekli güncellenen bir formülün başarılı olduğunu kanıtlıyor.

## 2. Grand Theft Auto V Remastered
Rockstar Games'in 2013'te yayınlanan ve current-gen konsollara remastered edilen suç sagası, masih bir güç olarak kabul ediliyor. GTA Online'ın sürekli popülaritesi ve GTA 6'nın beklentisi, oyuncuların Los Santos'ta hala大量 saatler geçirmesine neden oluyor. Bu da onu her 'en çok oynanan' listesinin önemli bir parçası haline getiriyor.

## 3. Roblox
Sadece bir oyun değil, kullanıcı tarafından oluşturulan deneyimlerin evreni olan Roblox, özellikle genç oyunculara hitap ediyor. Hem PlayStation hem de Xbox'ta üst sıralardaki varlığı, platformun inanılmaz erişimini ve sürekli değişen dijital oyun alanını ortaya koyuyor.

## 4. Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls
PS5 listesinde yeni bir giriş yapan Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, ilk 20'de yer alarak dikkat çekti. Marvel IP'sini kullanan bu dövüş oyunu, PlayStation oyuncularına yeni bir rekabet deneyimi sunuyor ve açıkça bir yankı uyandırdı.

## 5. Shift at Midnight
Benzer şekilde, Shift at Midnight, lansman haftasında Xbox Series X/S'te ilk 20'de yer alarak kendine bir yer açmayı başardı. Detaylar sınırlı olsa da, bu inclusion, kalabalık bir pazarda başarılı bir giriş yaptığını ve Xbox oyuncularına yeni bir oyun sunulduğunu gösteriyor.

Sonuç: Listelerin hala live-service oyunları tarafından domine edildiğini görüyoruz, ancak sadece birkaç yeni yayın bu kurulmuş elit gruba girmeyi başardı.

content_raw: A new series of social media posts by Circana’s Mat Piscatella gives us a fresh look at the top-played games on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Opting to showcase the top-20 list, Piscatella has noted that most of the games on the list are long-running live-service titles and yearly sports games. The only notable exceptions have been Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls on PS5 and Shift at Midnight on Xbox Series X/S. The charts represent weekly active users in the US for the week ending on July 25th. In a turn of events that shouldn’t be surprising to anyone paying attention to the games industry, Fortnite has taken the number one spot across PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. On the PlayStation side of things, the top 5 aside from Fortnite include NBA 2K26 , Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 , Roblox , and Grand Theft Auto 5 Remastered . Xbox, on the other hand, features Roblox , Call of Duty , Grand Theft Auto 5 Remastered , and Minecraft in its top 5. “Each list had exactly one new game reach the top 20. The rest were mostly long-running live service or annualized sports titles,” acknowledged Piscatella. “This is just the PS/XBX market right now.” In another post, he noted that the current market leads to “thousands of other games that come out every year fighting for the attention of a relatively small enthusiast portion of the total player base.” As we get deeper in both lists, we continue to see the trend of older live-service titles, like Apex Legends and Rocket League . There are a few exceptions to be seen, however. Palworld ’s recent 1.0 release likely played a large role in letting it breach the top 20 list, for instance. Similarly, on Xbox, Destiny 2 has managed to climb up to number 19. Curiously, the Xbox list also included Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced , which is entirely missing from the PS5 side. Shift at Midnight ’s absence from PlayStation’s list, on the other hand, is more understandable due to it simply not getting released on the platform. Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls ‘ presence on the PS5 list also represents an interesting data point, since the game hasn’t yet been released, and was only available for a single weekend. It looks like Steam is the only one of the three platforms to offer a more diverse list of the most-played games. Palworld currently sits at the top of the list, followed by Counter-Strike 2 , Battlefield 6 , Slay the Spire 2 , and Marvel Rivals rounding up the top 5. Further in, we also get to see titles like the indie hit Meccha Chameleon before more live-service games like Helldivers 2 , Destiny 2 , and Rocket League come in. The presence of Valve’s Deadlock is also noteworthy, since it is still an invite-only game that hasn’t yet been officially released to the public. Seeing lists like this that are broadly dominated by live-service games goes a long way in explaining the reasoning behind companies chasing similar trends, even if they happen to fail.
